proposed_widenings.name: build_time_exclusive_choice
proposed_widenings.justification: Divine Order presents a permanent, build-time exclusive-OR between two entirely different passive grant bundles (Protector vs Thaumaturge). No existing ClassFeatureMechanics family supports this: PassiveMechanics has a flat grants list (all apply), CompositeClassFeatureMechanics combines parts that all apply simultaneously, and ProficiencyGrant.choice only selects among proficiency subjects, not among whole feature packages. A new mechanism is needed — either a top-level 'suborder_choice' family for ClassFeatureMechanics or a 'build_time_or' wrapper that permanently selects one of several passive grant bundles at character creation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have dedicated yourself to one of the following sacred roles of your choice. Protector. [...] Thaumaturge. [...]

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access open-list cantrip choice
proposed_widenings.justification: Thaumaturge grants 'one extra cantrip from the Cleric spell list' — the cantrip is player-chosen from an open category, not a single fixed spellId. grant_spell_access.spellId is a string literal requiring a specific known ID. A new variant is needed to express an open-list spell-class grant (analogous to ProficiencyGrant.choice but for spells).
proposed_widenings.evidence: You know one extra cantrip from the Cleric spell list.

proposed_widenings.name: ability_modifier DiceDelta minimum constraint
proposed_widenings.justification: The Thaumaturge bonus is '+Wisdom modifier, minimum of +1'. The ability_modifier DiceDelta kind carries no minimum field, so the floor cannot be expressed. A minimum?: number optional field on the ability_modifier variant would cover this and similar patterns.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The bonus equals your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1).

notes: The Protector suborder encodes cleanly: grant_proficiency with weapon_category 'martial' + armor_category 'heavy' in a PassiveMechanics grants list. The Thaumaturge suborder is partially expressible (the Arcana/Religion skill bonus fits modify_roll_numeric with skillFilter and ability_modifier delta), but has two surface gaps (open-list cantrip grant, minimum modifier constraint). The dominant blocker is structural: no existing ClassFeatureMechanics family can express a permanent build-time OR between two different passive grant bundles. Both suborders need to live in one authored unit record.
